component.name: IPTV Player
component.summary: Watch IPTV channels, movies and series with VLC playback

description.p: A desktop IPTV client for Xtream Codes and M3U providers. It organises a provider's flat channel list into a TV / Movies / Series tree, plays through VLC's engine in an embedded window, downloads movies and episodes for offline viewing, and fetches subtitles from OpenSubtitles using the same keyless protocol as VLC's VLSub extension.
Built for large catalogs: tens of thousands of items are kept in SQLite and rendered through virtualized views, so memory stays flat no matter how big the list is.
VLC must be installed separately — this player uses its decoding engine but does not redistribute VideoLAN's binaries.
Full VLC control bar, keyless VLSub subtitles, daily catalog updates and resumable downloads.
